mapper.sql: LOG_ID AS logId, OCCURRED_AT AS occurredAt, EVENT_TYPE AS eventType, RESULT AS result, REASON_CODE AS reasonCode, ACCOUNT AS account, ACCOUNT_HASH AS accountHash, USER_ID AS userId, TENANT_ID AS tenantId, ORG_ID AS orgId, IP_ADDRESS AS ipAddress, BROWSER AS browser, DURATION_MS AS durationMs, TRACE_ID AS traceId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_LOGIN_LOG (LOG_ID, OCCURRED_AT, EVENT_TYPE, RESULT, REASON_CODE, ACCOUNT, ACCOUNT_HASH, USER_ID, TENANT_ID, ORG_ID, IP_ADDRESS, BROWSER, DURATION_MS, TRACE_ID) VALUES (#{logId}, #{occurredAt}, #{eventType}, #{result}, #{reasonCode}, #{account}, #{accountHash}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{orgId}, #{ipAddress}, #{browser}, #{durationMs}, #{traceId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PEACH_LOGIN_LOG WHERE OCCURRED_AT < #{cutoff} ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT, LOG_ID LIMIT 1000
